caption: Hands shape a lump of clay-like bread dough into a smooth, round boule on a wooden table.
relations: Hands press and rotate the dough lump, applying even force to compress and smooth its surface.
The dough deforms under pressure, spreading outward and upward to form a continuous, rounded shape.
Friction between hands and dough causes localized surface movement, reducing irregularities.
The wooden table supports the dough, resisting downward motion while allowing lateral shaping.
